name: Life spaceship f89d8f11 on 2-uniform tiling k2-003
description: A period-16 spaceship in Conway's Life (B3/S23) on the 2-uniform tiling k2-003, with touching neighbours, 8 to 16 cells, moving five lattice steps every 16 generations (5c/16). It runs the same way in the 2,048 rules from B3/S23 to B3,7,8,9,10/S2,3,7,8,9,10. It also runs in Life, unchanged, on k3-010 and k3-016. JETCARP's Life census met it in 563 of its 50,000 soups on this tiling.
